verdicts.reason: A reads left to right and keeps the headline dominant, but the Meridian logo is shrunk until it can't be read. The suitcase has been pulled off its blue circle, which now sits behind the CTA and sunglasses so the pill and glasses collide with it. The CTA text is tiny, and the body copy is about as heavy as the headline. B leaves a large empty strip on the left and packs headline, body and CTA into a cramped stack. It moves the logo down beside the CTA as a tiny footer item, the suitcase and circle are cut off at the bottom edge, and the CTA text is too small to read.
